<a id="op-put-api-v1-anonymous-access"></a>
### `PUT /api/v1/anonymous-access`

**Update Anonymous Access**

What requests without credentials may do (SPECIFICATION §4.9). Only repository permissions can be given
(no global action), and only ones the caller may give away; applied by every replica within moments.

Request body (required): `application/json` [`AnonymousAccess`](#schema-anonymousaccess)

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`AnonymousAccess`](#schema-anonymousaccess) |
| 403 | Forbidden | `application/problem+json` [`Problem`](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | Unprocessable Content | `application/problem+json` [`Problem`](#schema-problem) |

|---|---|---|---|---|

<a id="op-post-api-v1-auth-login"></a>
### `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

**Login**

Request body (required): `application/json` [`LoginRequest`](#schema-loginrequest)

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`Session`](#schema-session) |
| 202 | Password accepted; the second factor is needed | `application/json` [`SecondFactorRequired`](#schema-secondfactorrequired) |
| 401 | Bad credentials | - |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |
| 429 | Too many attempts | - |

<a id="op-post-api-v1-auth-login-totp"></a>
### `POST /api/v1/auth/login/totp`

**Login Second Factor**

Second sign-in step for accounts with two-factor sign-in: a TOTP code (each one works once) or a recovery
code (single use). Wrong codes count towards the account lockout; after a few the pending sign-in ends.

Request body (required): `application/json` [`SecondFactorLogin`](#schema-secondfactorlogin)

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`Session`](#schema-session) |
| 401 | Wrong code, or the pending sign-in expired (`code` `second_factor_expired`) | - |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |
| 429 | Too many attempts | - |

### `GET /api/v1/activity`

**List Activity**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | query | string \| null | no | maxLength: `512` |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | minimum: `1`; maximum: `500`; default: `50` |
| `repo` | query | string \| null | no |  |
| `kind` | query | `"download"` \| `"upload"` \| `"delete"` \| `"cache_miss"` \| `"upstream_state"` \| `"repository"` \| `"cleanup"` \| `"auth"` \| `"error"` \| `"storage"` \| null | no |  |
| `format` | query | `"docker"` \| `"npm"` \| `"apt"` \| `"raw"` \| `"yum"` \| `"pypi"` \| `"maven"` \| `"go"` \| `"helm"` \| `"terraform"` \| `"galaxy"` \| `"swift"` \| `"nuget"` \| `"cargo"` \| `"rubygems"` \| `"composer"` \| `"conda"` \| `"apk"` \| `"huggingface"` \| null | no |  |
| `principal` | query | string \| null | no | User name or client address (case-insensitive substring) (maxLength: `128`) |
| `cache` | query | `"HIT"` \| `"FETCHING"` \| `"COALESCED"` \| `"STALE"` \| `"REVALIDATED"` \| `"ERROR"` \| null | no |  |
| `outcome` | query | `"success"` \| `"failure"` \| `"info"` \| null | no |  |
| `since` | query | string (date-time) \| null | no | Only events at or after this time |
| `until` | query | string (date-time) \| null | no | Only events at or before this time |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`ActivityPage`](#schema-activitypage) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |

### `GET /api/v1/activity/export`

**Export Activity**

The filtered activity as CSV, streamed newest first, at most ``EXPORT_MAX_ROWS`` rows.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repo` | query | string \| null | no |  |
| `kind` | query | `"download"` \| `"upload"` \| `"delete"` \| `"cache_miss"` \| `"upstream_state"` \| `"repository"` \| `"cleanup"` \| `"auth"` \| `"error"` \| `"storage"` \| null | no |  |
| `format` | query | `"docker"` \| `"npm"` \| `"apt"` \| `"raw"` \| `"yum"` \| `"pypi"` \| `"maven"` \| `"go"` \| `"helm"` \| `"terraform"` \| `"galaxy"` \| `"swift"` \| `"nuget"` \| `"cargo"` \| `"rubygems"` \| `"composer"` \| `"conda"` \| `"apk"` \| `"huggingface"` \| null | no |  |
| `principal` | query | string \| null | no | User name or client address (case-insensitive substring) (maxLength: `128`) |
| `cache` | query | `"HIT"` \| `"FETCHING"` \| `"COALESCED"` \| `"STALE"` \| `"REVALIDATED"` \| `"ERROR"` \| null | no |  |
| `outcome` | query | `"success"` \| `"failure"` \| `"info"` \| null | no |  |
| `since` | query | string (date-time) \| null | no | Only events at or after this time |
| `until` | query | string (date-time) \| null | no | Only events at or before this time |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | CSV, newest first | `text/csv` string |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |

<a id="op-post-api-v1-repositories--name--clone"></a>
### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/clone`

**Clone Repository**

Create a repository with this one's configuration: upstream (and its stored secret), policies, options.

Content is not copied. Docker ``aliases`` and ``default_repo`` stay with the source (they name one repository);
the clone is never managed by the provisioning file. Needs ``manage`` on the source and ``admin`` (create).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body (required): `application/json` [`RepositoryClone`](#schema-repositoryclone)

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`Repository`](#schema-repository) |
| 409 | Conflict | `application/problem+json` [`Problem`](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | Unprocessable Content | `application/problem+json` [`Problem`](#schema-problem) |

## search

- [`GET /api/v1/search`](#op-get-api-v1-search)

<a id="op-get-api-v1-search"></a>
### `GET /api/v1/search`

**Search**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | no | `<name prefix>[ <version prefix>]` (case-insensitive; also matches the last `/` segment of a name), or a digest: `sha256:<8-64 hex>` / 64 hex digits. Empty lists everything (maxLength: `256`; default: `""`) |
| `format` | query | array of `"docker"` \| `"npm"` \| `"apt"` \| `"raw"` \| `"yum"` \| `"pypi"` \| `"maven"` \| `"go"` \| `"helm"` \| `"terraform"` \| `"galaxy"` \| `"swift"` \| `"nuget"` \| `"cargo"` \| `"rubygems"` \| `"composer"` \| `"conda"` \| `"apk"` \| `"huggingface"` \| null | no | maxItems: `20` |
| `repository` | query | array of string \| null | no | maxItems: `50` |
| `kind` | query | array of `"package"` \| `"image"` \| `"file"` \| null | no | maxItems: `3` |
| `type` | query | array of [`RepoType`](#schema-repotype) \| null | no | maxItems: `3` |
| `cached` | query | boolean | no | Only what is in the cache (leaves out apt/yum index listings) (default: `false`) |
| `facets` | query | boolean | no | Facet counts on the first page (default: `true`) |
| `cursor` | query | string \| null | no | Opaque cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor` (maxLength: `512`) |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | minimum: `1`; maximum: `100`; default: `50` |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [`SearchPage`](#schema-searchpage) |
| 400 | Bad Request | `application/problem+json` [`Problem`](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |

<a id="schemas"></a>
## Schemas

<a id="schema-action"></a>
### `Action`

Type: `"browse"` \| `"read"` \| `"write"` \| `"delete"` \| `"manage"` \| `"admin"` \| `"user-admin"` \| `"audit-read"` \| `"stats-read"` \| `"settings-admin"`

<a id="schema-activityevent"></a>
### `ActivityEvent`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Stream id; also the SSE `id:` |
| `ts` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `kind` | `"download"` \| `"upload"` \| `"delete"` \| `"cache_miss"` \| `"upstream_state"` \| `"repository"` \| `"cleanup"` \| `"auth"` \| `"error"` \| `"storage"` | yes |  |
| `summary` | string | yes | Plain-text one-liner (never rendered as HTML) |
| `outcome` | `"success"` \| `"failure"` \| `"info"` | yes |  |
| `repository` | string \| null | no |  |
| `format` | `"docker"` \| `"npm"` \| `"apt"` \| `"raw"` \| `"yum"` \| `"pypi"` \| `"maven"` \| `"go"` \| `"helm"` \| `"terraform"` \| `"galaxy"` \| `"swift"` \| `"nuget"` \| `"cargo"` \| `"rubygems"` \| `"composer"` \| `"conda"` \| `"apk"` \| `"huggingface"` \| null | no |  |
| `artifact` | string \| null | no |  |
| `path` | string \| null | no | Full path of the asset in the repository, when there is one |
| `principal` | string \| null | no |  |
| `cache` | `"HIT"` \| `"FETCHING"` \| `"COALESCED"` \| `"STALE"` \| `"REVALIDATED"` \| `"ERROR"` \| null | no |  |
| `bytes` | integer \| null | no |  |
| `duration_ms` | number \| null | no |  |

<a id="schema-activitypage"></a>
### `ActivityPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [`ActivityEvent`](#schema-activityevent) | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |

<a id="schema-activitystreamevent"></a>
### `ActivityStreamEvent`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `"activity"` | yes |  |
| `ts` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `event` | [`ActivityEvent`](#schema-activityevent) | yes |  |

<a id="schema-anonymousaccess"></a>
### `AnonymousAccess`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `roles` | array of string | yes | Roles of requests without credentials: `anonymous` (browse and read proxy repositories, the default) and/or roles holding repository permissions only; empty = no anonymous access (maxItems: `20`) |

<a id="schema-apitoken"></a>
### `ApiToken`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `prefix` | string | yes | The first characters of the token, for recognising it (`wst_` + 8) |
| `owner` | [`TokenOwnerRef`](#schema-tokenownerref) | yes |  |
| `scopes` | array of [`TokenScope`](#schema-tokenscope) | yes |  |
| `repositories` | array of string | yes | Repository patterns the token is limited to; empty = all |
| `status` | `"active"` \| `"expired"` \| `"revoked"` | yes |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) \| null | yes |  |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `last_used_at` | string (date-time) \| null | yes |  |
| `last_used_ip` | string \| null | yes |  |
| `revoked_at` | string (date-time) \| null | yes |  |

<a id="schema-apitokencreate"></a>
### `ApiTokenCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | What the token is for, e.g. `CI pipeline` (minLength: `1`; maxLength: `64`) |
| `scopes` | array of [`TokenScope`](#schema-tokenscope) | yes | minItems: `1`; maxItems: `7` |
| `repositories` | array of string | no | Limit the token to these repositories: names, globs (`docker-*`), `format:<f>`, `type:<t>` (maxItems: `20`) |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) \| null | no | null = never expires |

<a id="schema-apitokencreated"></a>
### `ApiTokenCreated`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | [`ApiToken`](#schema-apitoken) | yes |  |
| `secret` | string | yes | The token. Shown only in this response; store it now |

<a id="schema-apitokenlist"></a>
### `ApiTokenList`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [`ApiToken`](#schema-apitoken) | yes |  |
| `available_scopes` | array of [`TokenScope`](#schema-tokenscope) | yes | Scopes the owner may put on a new token |

<a id="schema-apkoptions"></a>
### `ApkOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branch` | string | no | Alpine branch for "Set me up", prefetch items without a path and "test upstream" (e.g. `v3.22`, `edge`, `latest-stable`) (minLength: `1`; maxLength: `64`; pattern: `"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"`; default: `"latest-stable"`) |
| `repositories` | array of string | no | Alpine repositories (below the branch) for "Set me up" and prefetch items without a path (minItems: `1`; maxItems: `16`) |
| `architectures` | array of string | no | Architectures that prefetch items without a path warm (e.g. `x86_64`, `aarch64`) (minItems: `1`; maxItems: `16`) |

<a id="schema-apkpackage"></a>
### `ApkPackage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `latest_version` | string \| null | no | Newest version (apk version order) |
| `arches` | array of string | yes |  |
| `version_count` | integer | yes | Distinct versions |
| `description` | string \| null | no |  |
| `origin` | string \| null | no | Source package (APKBUILD) it was built from |

<a id="schema-apkpackagepage"></a>
### `ApkPackagePage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [`ApkPackage`](#schema-apkpackage) | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |

<a id="schema-apkversion"></a>
### `ApkVersion`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | yes | `<version>-r<release>` |
| `arch` | string | yes |  |
| `branch` | string | yes | Alpine branch, e.g. v3.22 |
| `repository` | string | yes | Alpine repository below the branch, e.g. main |
| `directory` | string | yes | The `<branch>/<repository>/<arch>` directory whose APKINDEX lists it |
| `path` | string | yes | Path of the .apk file in the repository |
| `size_bytes` | integer \| null | no |  |
| `installed_size` | integer \| null | no |  |
| `checksum` | string \| null | no | APKINDEX `C:` value: `Q1` + base64 SHA-1 of the control segment |
| `verified` | boolean | yes | Listed by a cached (proxy) or generated (hosted) APKINDEX |
| `cached` | boolean | yes | The .apk file is stored |
| `license` | string \| null | no |  |
| `origin` | string \| null | no |  |
| `url` | string \| null | no |  |
| `build_time` | string (date-time) \| null | no |  |
| `depends` | array of string | yes |  |
| `uploaded_at` | string (date-time) \| null | no |  |
| `uploaded_by` | string \| null | no |  |
| `download_url` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-apkversionpage"></a>
### `ApkVersionPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package` | [`ApkPackage`](#schema-apkpackage) | yes |  |
| `items` | array of [`ApkVersion`](#schema-apkversion) | yes | Newest first (apk version order) |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |

<a id="schema-aptoptions"></a>
### `AptOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `distribution` | string | yes | Proxy: informational default suite, e.g. `trixie`. Hosted: the distribution the repository publishes (`dists/<distribution>/`; one directory, no `/`) (maxLength: `100`; pattern: `"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,99}$"`) |
| `flat` | boolean | no | Flat repository layout (no `dists/`); proxy only (default: `false`) |
| `components` | array of string | no | Hosted: the components uploads may go to (`?component=`, default the first); each is published (minItems: `1`; maxItems: `16`) |
| `architectures` | array of string | no | Hosted: the architectures always published (`binary-<arch>`; `Architecture: all` packages are listed in each); architectures of uploaded packages are added (minItems: `1`; maxItems: `16`) |

### `AptPackage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `version` | string | yes |  |

| `component` | string | yes |  |

| `cached` | boolean | yes |  |
| `verified` | boolean \| null | no | Cached file matched the index hash; null if not cached |
| `last_downloaded_at` | string (date-time) \| null | no |  |
| `downloads` | integer | no | default: `0` |

<a id="schema-autoblockconfig-input"></a>
### `AutoBlockConfig-Input`

Stop calling a failing upstream for a while (SPECIFICATION §4.1).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | no | default: `true` |
| `failures` | integer | no | Consecutive upstream failures that block it (minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `1000.0`; default: `5`) |
| `initial_s` | integer | no | First block period (seconds) (minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `86400.0`; default: `30`) |
| `max_s` | integer | no | Longest block period (seconds); the period doubles after every failed probe (minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `604800.0`; default: `1800`) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dist_hosts` | array of string | no | Hosts the proxy fetches and caches package archives (dist URLs) from; the upstream URL's host is always allowed too. Dist URLs on other hosts are left unchanged (the client fetches them itself). Proxy repositories only (maxItems: `50`) |
| `source_mode` | `"keep"` \| `"strip"` | no | `keep` leaves each version's `source` (VCS) entry in the metadata; `strip` removes it so clients can only install the cached archives (dev branches without an archive become uninstallable). Proxy repositories only (default: `"keep"`) |

Unique across repositories, not the base URL port; the web tier must listen on it too (WAYSTATION_DOCKER_CONNECTORS, operator work). null = none (minimum: `1024`; maximum: `65535`; default: `null`) |

<a id="schema-gooptions"></a>
### `GoOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sumdb_proxy` | boolean | no | Proxy the checksum database at `sumdb/<name>/` so clients verify modules without direct access to it (proxy repositories; groups use their first proxy member that does) (default: `true`) |
| `sumdb_name` | string | no | Name of the checksum database (GOSUMDB) (maxLength: `200`; pattern: `"^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$"`; default: `"sum.golang.org"`) |
| `sumdb_url` | string | no | URL of the checksum database (the SSRF guard applies as for the upstream) (maxLength: `500`; pattern: `"^https?://[^\\s?#]+$"`; default: `"https://sum.golang.org"`) |
| `verify_checksums` | boolean | no | Verify `.mod` and `.zip` files against the checksum database before caching them (modules matching `nosumdb` are not looked up) (default: `true`) |
| `nosumdb` | array of string | no | Module path patterns never looked up in the checksum database (GONOSUMDB syntax: a glob per path prefix, e.g. `example.com/private/*`): private modules (maxItems: `100`) |

<a id="schema-prefetchconfig-input"></a>
### `PrefetchConfig-Input`

Prefetch (SPECIFICATION §4.1): keep popular metadata fresh, warm a list of packages or images.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh_popular` | boolean | no | Revalidate the most downloaded metadata (tags, package indexes) before it goes stale, so clients get fresh cache hits (default: `false`) |
| `warm` | array of string | no | Items to keep cached, one per entry, in the format's syntax: docker `nginx:1.27` (optionally followed by platforms, `nginx:1.27 linux/amd64,linux/arm64`), npm `lodash@4.17.21`, a raw file path... (maxItems: `200`) |
| `schedule` | string \| null | no | When the warm list runs: 5-field UTC cron, a macro such as `@daily`, or `@every <n>m\|h`; null = only when run by hand (maxLength: `100`) |

<a id="schema-prefetchconfig-output"></a>

Prefetch (SPECIFICATION §4.1): keep popular metadata fresh, warm a list of packages or images.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh_popular` | boolean | yes | Revalidate the most downloaded metadata (tags, package indexes) before it goes stale, so clients get fresh cache hits (default: `false`) |
| `warm` | array of string | yes | Items to keep cached, one per entry, in the format's syntax: docker `nginx:1.27` (optionally followed by platforms, `nginx:1.27 linux/amd64,linux/arm64`), npm `lodash@4.17.21`, a raw file path... (maxItems: `200`) |
| `schedule` | string \| null | yes | When the warm list runs: 5-field UTC cron, a macro such as `@daily`, or `@every <n>m\|h`; null = only when run by hand (maxLength: `100`) |

<a id="schema-storageconfig-input"></a>
### `StorageConfig-Input`

Stored-bytes quota (SPECIFICATION §4.8). Usage counts every asset the repository holds (a blob shared with other repositories counts in each of them).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quota_bytes` | integer \| null | no | Quota in bytes; null = no quota (group repositories: always null) (minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `9007199254740992.0`) |
| `quota_mode` | [`QuotaMode`](#schema-quotamode) | no | `soft`: warn at 80 % and 100 %; `hard`: also refuse uploads and new cache fills once reached (cached content is still served; proxy downloads pass through uncached) (default: `"soft"`) |

<a id="schema-storageconfig-output"></a>
### `StorageConfig-Output`

Stored-bytes quota (SPECIFICATION §4.8). Usage counts every asset the repository holds (a blob shared with other repositories counts in each of them).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Upstream credentials. Secrets are write-only; reads return ``secret_set`` instead.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [`AuthKind`](#schema-authkind) | no | default: `"none"` |
| `username` | string \| null | no | maxLength: `256` |
| `secret` | string \| null | no | Password or token. Omit or null on update to keep the stored secret. (maxLength: `4096`) (writeOnly) |
| `secret_set` | boolean | no | default: `false` (readOnly) |

<a id="schema-upstreamauth-output"></a>
### `UpstreamAuth-Output`

Upstream credentials. Secrets are write-only; reads return ``secret_set`` instead.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `username` | string \| null | yes | maxLength: `256` |
| `secret_set` | boolean | yes | default: `false` (readOnly) |

<a id="schema-webhookwrite"></a>
### `WebhookWrite`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | pattern: `"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,62}$"` |
| `description` | string | no | maxLength: `500`; default: `""` |
| `url` | string | yes | Where events are POSTed (http or https) (minLength: `8`; maxLength: `2048`) |
| `events` | array of `"*"` \| `"content.*"` \| `"repository.*"` \| `"content.upload"` \| `"content.delete"` \| `"content.update"` \| `"repository.create"` \| `"repository.update"` \| `"repository.delete"` | yes | minItems: `1`; maxItems: `20` |
| `repositories` | array of string | no | Repository name globs (`*`, `?`, case-insensitive); empty = every repository (maxItems: `50`) |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | default: `true` |
| `secret` | string \| null | no | HMAC-SHA256 signing key (write-only). Required when creating; null keeps the stored one (minLength: `16`; maxLength: `256`) (writeOnly) |
| `headers` | object of string \| null | no | Extra request headers (write-only; values may be credentials). Null keeps the stored ones (writeOnly) |
| `allow_private` | boolean | no | Allow targets on private or reserved addresses (default: `false`) |
| `timeout_s` | integer | no | minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `30.0`; default: `10` |
| `max_attempts` | integer | no | minimum: `1.0`; maximum: `20.0`; default: `8` |

<a id="schema-writepolicy"></a>
### `WritePolicy`

Hosted repositories (SPECIFICATION §4.2): may an existing version (docker: a tag) be overwritten?

Type: `"allow_redeploy"` \| `"disable_redeploy"` \| `"read_only"`

<a id="schema-yumoptions"></a>
### `YumOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repo_path` | string | no | Path of the yum repository (the directory holding `repodata/`) below the upstream URL, as used in the `.repo` `baseurl`, e.g. `$releasever/BaseOS/$basearch/os/`. Empty: derived for well-known upstreams, else the repository root. Only used by "Set me up" and "test upstream" (maxLength: `200`; pattern: `"^[A-Za-z0-9$_.{}+/-]*$"`; default: `""`) |
| `gpg_key` | string \| null | no | `gpgkey` for the "Set me up" `.repo` file. Empty: the distribution key for well-known upstreams (maxLength: `500`; pattern: `"^(file|https?)://[^\\s]+$"`; default: `null`) |
| `repomd_keys` | string \| null | no | Armored OpenPGP public key block(s) of the upstream (e.g. the distribution's `RPM-GPG-KEY-*`). When set, a `repomd.xml` is cached only when its `repomd.xml.asc` verifies with one of these keys, and the verified `.asc` is served with it. Only for upstreams that sign `repomd.xml` (Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux); EPEL and Oracle Linux do not (maxLength: `65536`; default: `null`) |
